craft_notes: Sthāyin: Wonder at all-containing, marveled into refuge. End-dash→comma (babble softens onto hail). Rejected: 'tipsy' for 'glad-drunk' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Blessed Brahmā's brood, prattle past, who babble glad-drunk,
l4.sanskrit_cite: aho brahmādayo dhanyā ye vimuktānyasaṃkatham namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ

reads_against.argmap: Ah, blessed Brahmā and others who dropped all other talk. → Blessed are those chanting Śiva, dropped all else.
c1_essence: Blessed chanters dropping all talk but Śiva's name.

l2.plain_english: Ah, lucky Brahmā and the rest — dropped all chatter, drunk with delight they mumble: Śiva, hail, hail.
l2.sanskrit_cite: aho brahmādayo dhanyā ye vimuktānyasaṃkatham namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ

l3: Blessed Brahmā's brood, prattle past, who babble glad-drunk —
reads_against.t1: Ah, blessed are Brahmā and others who, having dropped all other talk, mutter overwhelmed with joy 'homage, homage to Śiva'.
